text:
incident-bot: ALERT — p99 latency breach detected for customer Bluehaven (VPC) on bh-dedicated-usw2. p99 trending 4.3s > SLO 1.2s. Auto-escalating to on-call. :rotating_light:
oncall-eng: I'm paged, joining. Can someone paste the initial graph?
megan.s: grabbing perf dashboard now — spikes start ~08:12 UTC, correlates with increased tail latency on model lx-large-q4.
raj.k: seen similar in logs, looks like KV cache miss rate jumped to 72% for that pool. Possibly cache eviction from tenant burst.
amanda-sre: running quick health check on pool nodes. `rgx list-pool bh-dedicated-usw2 --status`
amanda-sre: output: 12/12 nodes healthy, CPU ok, load normal, but one node showing elevated GPU mem alloc transiently.
infra-lead: routing telemetry shows a traffic surge from tenant bluehaven-prod: request rate doubled for 60s starting 08:11. Could be a client retry storm.
megan.s: recommendation: apply temporary tenant-level throttling to bluehaven-prod to protect other tenants. We can set 50% of their burst allowance.
oncall-eng: before throttling, attempt KV cache warm and pin popular prefixes. Can we prime cache?
raj.k: starting prefix warm task: `cache-warm --pool bh-dedicated-usw2 --tenant bluehaven-prod --prefixes-file /tmp/bh_hot.txt &`
cust-ops-liaison: notifying Bluehaven ops on their incident channel: "We see elevated tail latency; doing mitigations now. We'll update in 15m."
amanda-sre: enacted short-term mitigation: enabled tenant throttling rule `tenant_rate_limit: bluehaven-prod = 60rps` and scaled the pool +2 replicas (pending).
incident-bot: NOTE — autoscale request accepted for bh-dedicated-usw2: +2 replicas. Estimated add time 90s.
infra-lead: also routing fallback: divert new low-priority traffic to fallback model lx-medium-q4 (compatible), set by policy for latency-tiered fallback.
megan.s: pushed fallback rule: `routing.set-fallback --pool bh-dedicated-usw2 --from lx-large-q4 --to lx-medium-q4 --pct 30` — applied.
raj.k: cache-warm shows success for top 50 prefixes, KV hit rate now 61% (up from 28%). p99 improving but still ~2.1s.
oncall-eng: scaling finished, new replicas reporting, load distributed. p99 at 1.4s and trending down.
amanda-sre: keeping throttling in place until we confirm stable for 10m. Also scheduling a graceful tenant traffic window to let them back to normal.
cust-ops-liaison: Bluehaven replied: they saw a short spike in request fan-out after a deploy on their side at 08:10. They're rolling back that change now.
megan.s: good to know — root cause likely client deploy causing retry/fanout causing cache churn. We should add a post-incident action: recommend client-side backoff and suggest request batching if they have sudden bursts.
oncall-eng: agree. I'll start a postmortem once incident closed. For now, will monitor for 15m.
incident-bot: UPDATE — p99 reduced to 0.98s. SLO restored. Logging incident as P1 for follow-up: "Bluehaven dedicated pool transient p99 breach due to tenant-induced cache churn."
amanda-sre: creating follow-up ticket and scheduling join with Bluehaven for runbook alignment.
raj.k: saving logs and attaching sampling trace: `s3://incidents/7623451234/trace-samples.zip`
megan.s: closing war room in 10m if stable. Thanks everyone. :slightly_smiling_face:
